text: A very special island is inhabited only by knights and knaves. Knights always tell the truth, and knaves always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Joseph, and David. In a statement by Joseph: "David is a knave or David is a knight". David commented, "Joseph is a knave or Joseph is a knight". So who is a knight and who is a knave? (Format your answer like: "Joseph is a knight/knave, and David is a knight/knave")
